name: youtube-extended-search-flashdata
description: Search larger YouTube video result sets, with up to 700 requested results. Map recurring channels and topics from structured video records. Uses the paid FlashData API.

FLASHDATA_API_KEY.title: FlashData API key
FLASHDATA_API_KEY.description: FlashData API key from https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys with youtube_search_extended enabled. Data calls use paid Credits; pricing and job reads are free.
